soundness_bridge.statement: ∀ (v n : ℕ) (hv : 0 < v) (d : List (List ℕ)), 20 * n + 1 = v → Cdf.Kernel.coverMask v n d = Cdf.Kernel.fullMask v → Cdf.IsCDF (Cdf.Kernel.blockOf v hv n d)
soundness_bridge.proof_idea: The mask equality says that the set of computed ordered differences (the value of Fin.sub on the raw residues) is exactly {1, ..., v-1}. Hence no difference is 0, which gives injective blocks and count 0 at zero, and every nonzero residue is hit. The 20n index triples map onto the v-1 nonzero residues, so Finset.inj_on_of_surj_on_of_card_le makes the map injective, and every nonzero residue has count exactly 1.

def Cdf.devBlock : {v n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Fin 5 → Fin v) → Fin n × Fin v → Finset (Fin v) :=
fun {v n} B p => Finset.image (fun j => B p.1 j + p.2) Finset.univ
def Cdf.IsStrictlyCyclicSteiner : {v n : ℕ} → (Fin n → Fin 5 → Fin v) → Prop :=
fun {v n} B =>
  (∀ (p : Fin n × Fin v), (Cdf.devBlock B p).card = 5) ∧
    (∀ (x y : Fin v), x ≠ y → ∃! p, x ∈ Cdf.devBlock B p ∧ y ∈ Cdf.devBlock B p) ∧
      Function.Injective (Cdf.devBlock B) ∧
        ∀ (p : Fin n × Fin v) (t : Fin v),
          Finset.image (fun x => x + t) (Cdf.devBlock B p) = Cdf.devBlock B (p.1, p.2 + t)
def Cdf.IsPerfectOOC : {v n : ℕ} → [NeZero v] → (Fin n → Fin 5 → Fin v) → Prop :=
fun {v n} [NeZero v] B =>
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (Cdf.devBlock B (i, 0)).card = 5) ∧
    (∀ (i i' : Fin n) (τ : Fin v), (i, 0) ≠ (i', τ) → (Cdf.devBlock B (i, 0) ∩ Cdf.devBlock B (i', τ)).card ≤ 1) ∧
      20 * n = v - 1
@Cdf.sub_eq_iff_modEq : ∀ {v : ℕ} (a b d : Fin v), a - b = d ↔ ↑↑d ≡ ↑↑a - ↑↑b [ZMOD ↑v]
@Cdf.IsCDF.existsUnique : ∀ {v n : ℕ} {B : Fin n → Fin 5 → Fin v},
  Cdf.IsCDF B → ∀ (d : Fin v), ↑d ≠ 0 → ∃! t, t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2 ∧ B t.1 t.2.1 - B t.1 t.2.2 = d
@Cdf.IsCDF.card_eq : ∀ {v n : ℕ} {B : Fin n → Fin 5 → Fin v}, Cdf.IsCDF B → 20 * n = v - 1
@Cdf.bridge_of_target : ∀ {v : ℕ} [inst : NeZero v],
  Cdf.Target v → ∃ n B, Cdf.IsCDF B ∧ Cdf.IsStrictlyCyclicSteiner B ∧ Cdf.IsPerfectOOC B
